subject: Is there any problem in my MSStatsTMT file formation (attached)

messages.author: c632a0ae6f022002
messages.subject: Is there any problem in my MSStatsTMT file formation (attached)
parts:
Dear All

I am just begining with MSStatsTMT. I am trying to run this file via using MSStatsTMT module of Galaxy tools and this is throwing up the error.

"Error in .checkSummarizationParams(data, method, global_norm, reference_norm"

I am sharing the data file. If anyone could point out any issue in the formatting, it would be very helpful.

Regards
Debojyoti

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Is there any problem in my MSStatsTMT file formation (attached)
parts:
Hi Debojyoti,

It looks like the "Mixture" column is empty, this needs to be filled for your analysis to work. Are you uploading this file directly into Galaxy under "MSstatsTMT (11 column format)"? If so you will just need to include the Mixture info. Otherwise there is probably an issue in your annotation file.

Devon
